assign.title: Budget: $3. Load the minion skill first. Investigate only, read-only, no edits, report one screen: the owner sees transc

log.msg: Root cause found (read-only investigation, no edits): Sessions.js assign_prompt()/prompt_close_ms (Servex/agents/Sessions.js:548-558,1273-1286) merges unrelated owner utterances into one Prompt/message when they land within the 8s close window and no assistant reply arrives to close it early. Live evidence: public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/03/v-z0jonhy/session.jsonl lines 113-138 — four distinct sentences ('In this technological form.'/'You'll answer your question.'/'Thank you.'/'I don't answer your question.') folded into one prompt p-1793729237961 / message m-1793729237967 because the smart seat was busy spawning the mastermind task and sent no reply to trigger an early close. Checked and NOT the cause: reply-splits-open-bubble (guarded by :1281-1285, this.thoughts.get(s.id)?.lines.length check) and Whisper chunk-boundary overlap (every pushed text is a clean, complete, non-overlapping sentence; no raw bucket.jsonl exists for this window to fully rule out). place/improve edits (lines 10,32,51,71,89,101,131,139,141,144,159,167,182,199) only retarget one sentence id each via messages.clean, never reorder others. Smallest fix proposed, not applied: close the prompt on a semantic boundary (sentence-ending punctuation + floor:done) instead of pure elapsed time, or shorten SERVEX_SESSION_PROMPT_CLOSE_MS.

complete.outcome: Found the mingled-chat root cause: Sessions.js assign_prompt()/prompt_close_ms merges unrelated owner sentences into one Prompt/message when the smart seat's reply is slow.
caveats: Could not cross-check raw Whisper audio-segment boundaries (no bucket.jsonl entries for this session's time window) to fully rule out chunking as a secondary contributor
